title: PNW Components Silver Loam Gen 2 Dropper Posts Are Back (For Now)
content:
PNW Components just announced a super-limited restock of its silver Loam Gen 2 dropper posts. These will literally fly off the shelves, so if you’re frothing for one, roll on over to PNW Components now to swoop. There’s no telling if they’ll keep making these since the clear anodizing is hard to nail each round perfectly…
